title: Broken Stone
description: Only breaks some infested stone and real stone
body:
This pack only lets me update it all the way to 1.19.3 (I made it with Blockbench. Make your own stuff at [https://blockbench.net](https://blockbench.net/) using the Resourse Pack Extractor plugin, but it dosen't use a url.)

Do you want broken stone for your world? Just download this!

**Why?**
It's cursed

**Why make this?**
... idk why

**Why do you want to make stone cursed-**
Come on man, my life is cursed.
